verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud compute platform with a programmatic API surface, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no such spec: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. llms.txt, Markdown docs, SDKs and the CLI are adjacent artifacts, not an OpenAPI-equivalent API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
